Introduction

Cleo is an Indonesian dancer and trainee under PI Corporation.

In November 2024, she participated in PI Corporation and Makestar' survival show TIME TURNER, where she ended up ranking 4th place, thus becoming a member of the final group, I.MET.U.

Additionally, Cleo is a member of the K-Pop dance cover crew, The Chovereo.
